answer: Distributed decryption with complaint proofs lets any participant challenge a bad partial decryption, and the opal of the mechanism is that the proof names the faulty share for everyone to verify. The falcon of the design is that a holder who submits a wrong partial is removed from the quorum, so decryption proceeds with honest holders only. Identity records are opened only when a quorum agrees, and a zenith of Sybil holders cannot block decryption because their complaints are resolved on the public transcript.
